title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs/quickstarts
author: Aisha Khan
description:
Motivation: Provide first-class RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts so engineers can get started with Retrieval-Augmented Generation and tool-enabled agents using Redwood runtime. This PR adds opinionated templates (python + typescript), multiple tool-calling examples (HTTP data fetch, calendar lookup, and basic DB query helper), and docs site quickstarts + TOC updates.

What changed (high level):
- docs/agents/rag-templates.md: new guide with decision points (when to use RAG vs. closed-book, storage choices, chunking recommendations).
- docs/agents/tool-calling.md: new reference for wiring external tools, safe execution patterns, and examples.
- examples/agents/python_tool_calling_example.py: runnable quickstart that demonstrates a tool interface, example tool adapter, and local dev instructions.
- examples/agents/ts_tool_calling_example.ts: Typescript/Node quickstart showing Redwood SDK usage and tool registration.
- website sidebars and quickstart index updated to surface the new content.
- small README and playground snippets added under redwood-examples to demonstrate end-to-end flow.

Checklist: 
- [x] Add RAG templates and decision guide
- [x] Add Python + TS tool-calling quickstarts
- [x] Update docs site TOC and quickstarts index
- [x] Add basic unit tests for example helpers
- [x] Manual smoke test of docs site build and example execution

Usage note: the python quickstart requires REDWOOD_API_KEY in env and shows how to register a simple HTTP tool. Example snippet (python quickstart):

from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
# register example tool
client.register_tool('fetch_user_profile', lambda user_id: http_get(f'https://example.internal/users/{user_id}'))

The examples are intentionally minimal; production integrations should add authentication, rate limiting, and idempotency guards.

Related: ENG-3124 tracks follow-ups for adding more persistent example datasets and test harnesses. This PR is focused on discoverability and initial templates for customers and internal demos.
